events.title: Switzerland's upper house voted to require UBS to back its foreign units with 90% CET1 capital, after lobbying by business groups and a public clash between the finance minister and UBS.
events.reason: A legislative step on capital rules for a G-SIB, with significant prudential and competitive implications.

events.title: Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman set out the final overhaul of the stress test framework used to set bank capital requirements.
events.reason: A major change in how US large-bank capital requirements are set.

events.title: Bowman released initial findings of the independent Starling review of SVB's failure and of shortcomings in Fed supervision.
events.reason: Significant findings on supervisory effectiveness that are directly relevant to supervisors.

events.title: The Basel Committee's monitoring report shows Group 1 banks' capital and leverage ratios stable at end-2025, LCR slightly up, NSFR slightly down, and a +2.2% Tier 1 MRC impact from full Basel III.
events.reason: A core Basel III data point, but it shows stability, so it is secondary in a short answer.

events.title: The FATF evaluation found Turkey has strengthened its AML/CFT regime but must do more to trace cross-border proceeds and recover illicit assets.
events.reason: A relevant AML/CFT assessment, but of a single jurisdiction and lower priority.

output.state_reason: The Swiss legislative push for much higher UBS capital is contested and still in progress. The SVB review exposes supervisory failings and the US stress test overhaul changes how capital is set. All three are developing and could become material. Enforcement this week was routine, and there was no acute incident needing immediate follow-up.
